difficulty_reason: Constructs the Ext^2 obstruction class for realising a given c on a first order thickening of ringed topoi: flat cover H' -> F, the induced diagram on IH'/IJ, the dotted arrow from injectivity of K, pushout to build F', and the general case via embedding K into an injective hull with the class read off Ext^1(F,Q)=Ext^2(F,K); both necessity and sufficiency are argued in span. Retained author proof at lines 2963-3077.
